security_spec.violation_condition: QEMU's dcsr write handler does not enforce WARL behavior on dcsr.prv: writing an unsupported privilege mode (e.g., S-mode when only M/U are implemented, or a reserved encoding) is accepted verbatim rather than being warped to a supported mode. When the hart exits Debug Mode, it resumes in an invalid or nonexistent privilege level.
security_spec.summary: Unvalidated dcsr.prv write allows debugger to force hart into unsupported privilege mode on Debug Mode exit, escaping architectural privilege boundaries
